score_kind: heuristic visual similarity (not a calibrated probability)
verdict: Render is faithful to the original: same points, segments, and arc extent; the only visible difference is label typeface weight.

issues.description: Point labels are set in regular-weight math italic, while the original labels are visibly bold. Position and spelling are correct; only the font weight differs (example: label F).
